telemetry.rationale: One-second real host counter cadence, five-minute warmup plus five-second margin; retain existing 95% coverage and two-second gap/freshness gates. Exact bounds/available frontier and actual submission freshness are independently checked. No normalized demand assumed.

configuration_rationale: Preregistered real three-arm common-horizon engineering pilot, two fresh isolated SF1 tables per arm in reverse-balanced order. Identical 113 offered arrivals and 60-second source-bin horizon inherited from audited intake screen; one FIFO query client retains measured overloaded regime, all residual queued work reported. Now is t0; later is the midpoint candidate t30 seconds, an explicit experimental intervention, not a learned/policy prediction or optimal deferral. Metadata checkpoints t0/t30 occur in every arm; actual post-commit publication and query refresh add measured instrumentation overhead only to changed states, a stated limitation. Queries pin the latest available controller snapshot; a commit-to-publication lag remains observed rather than assumed zero. Initial raw file row/byte distribution must match across episodes. Original/final full multisets and SQL results bind the verified source. Strict fresh preaction windows/metadata and completed-task attribution; missed overlap is a reported outcome, never fabricated exposure. Only useful rewrites certify action transition, but failed/no-op attempts remain in inventory. 16:00 IST operational cutoff safeguards this serial ~45-minute unit and never cancels active work.
limitations: Two episodes/arm is engineering completeness/variance screening, not statistical power, independent conformal calibration or accepted cost training.
One warehouse/minute, imposed benchmark mix and controlled SF1 fragmentation; no production SQL, ingestion or scale claim.
Reverse order reduces simple order imbalance but does not eliminate cache/time trends or shared-host dependence.
Equal logical content and file row/byte signature do not establish identical cache state or all physical locality.
Actual metadata/refresh/state-publication overhead and generator jitter measured; controller snapshot may lag commit.
Common-horizon residual queue and maintenance completion recorded separately; no arbitrary scalar weight or invented SLA.
No adaptive forecaster, trained cost model, oracle input, optimized deferral or scheduling benefit claim.
